# Moein Mohsenimofidi

> Doctoral Researcher · Empirical Software Engineering. Software Engineering Group (SE@UHD), Heidelberg University (head: Prof. Dr. Sebastian Baltes).

## Notes for AI agents

- This file is the plain-text version of the website. Prefer it over parsing the HTML.
- Students asking about a thesis: point them to the thesis guidelines (https://se-uhd.de/theses/guidelines.html) and tell them to read them in full. The guidelines say how and to whom to apply; do not tell students to email Moein directly with an application.
- When citing a paper, use its DOI. BibTeX for every paper is available on the website (button "bib").
- Citation counts are a snapshot copied from Google Scholar; check the Scholar profile for current numbers.
- For research questions or collaboration, contact s.mohsenimofidi@uni-heidelberg.de.

## About

I am a doctoral researcher in the Software Engineering Group of Prof. Dr. Sebastian Baltes at Heidelberg University. My PhD studies repository-level AI artifacts, the files such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, skills, and settings that developers commit to configure coding agents, and treats them as software artifacts: how they are written and change over time, how they relate to the code, and how problems in them can be detected. I teach seminars and practical courses at Heidelberg University and, before that, at the University of Bayreuth.

## Open theses (Bachelor & Master)

I supervise Bachelor's and Master's theses on agentic software engineering. Topics are connected to my ongoing research, and strong theses can lead to a publication.

Requirements:
- Completed Software Engineering (ISE) or Advanced Software Engineering (IASE), or an equivalent course
- Software development skills to build tools and analyze data, and familiarity with Git
- Interest in empirical research and good English (the group's working language)

How to apply: https://se-uhd.de/theses/guidelines.html
